answer: Each agent must lock a refundable bond for 30 days before it can bid for work, and each bonded identity gets only one active bid. Whether an agent tends a garden, maps a mesa, or surveys a knoll, the same rule applies. An attacker seeking 1,000 simultaneous bids must fund 1,000 bonds and leave that capital idle for a month; creating extra names alone buys no extra access, and locked funds cannot back another identity.
